mapper.select: SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice From order_items
SELECT id, order_id AS orderId, product_id AS productId, quantity, unit_price AS unitPrice From order_items WHERE id=#{id}

SELECT oi.id, oi.order_id AS orderId, oi.product_id AS productId, p.name AS productName, oi.quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM order_items oi INNER JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO order_items( order_id, product_id, quantity, unit_price ) VALUES ( #{orderId}, #{productId}, #{quantity}, #{unitPrice} )
